scope: Read-only current selection writer, closure guards and reader schemas; no user rows or secrets.

functions.name: private.push_session_valid
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.push_session_valid(p_user uuid, p_session uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 select p_session is not null and exists(select 1 from auth.sessions s join auth.users u on u.id=s.user_id
 where s.id=p_session and s.user_id=p_user and (s.not_after is null or s.not_after>clock_timestamp())
 and u.deleted_at is null and (u.banned_until is null or u.banned_until<=clock_timestamp()));
$function$

functions.name: private.closure_account_restricted
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.closure_account_restricted(a uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ select exists(select 1 from private.account_closure_requests r where r.account_id=a
 and r.state in('READY','EXECUTING','FAILED','CLOSED')); $function$
